description: Vintage signage: hand-painted shop-sign lettering, warm and nostalgic, light background. Suits bakeries, food stalls, workshops, traditional family businesses.
Luxury and refined: elegant serif type, generous space, calm and premium, light background. Suits real estate, beauty salons, clinics, upscale services.
Brutally minimal on a dark background: stark type, strong contrast, few elements. Suits modern services, workshops, barbers, tech or design businesses.
Soft pastel: gentle colors, rounded shapes, friendly and light. Suits cafés, bakeries, kids, beauty, wellness, small shops.
Art deco and geometric: bold symmetric patterns, gold-like accents, classic glamour, light background. Suits restaurants, bars, events, real estate, salons.
